Reports suggest that **Vijay**'s party is gaining traction in urban areas, prompting speculation about a potential alliance with the **Congress**, which was previously considered before joining the **DMK-led Secular Progressive Alliance**.

recent_articles.title: Congress leaders introspect on not aligning with TVK - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** leaders are expressing regret over their decision to not form an alliance with actor **C. Joseph Vijay**’s **Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)**, believing they missed a chance to rejuvenate the party in Tamil Nadu.  Some members suggest leaving the DMK-led Secular Progressive Alliance immediately and forming an alliance with the TVK if needed to prevent the BJP from coming to power. The TNCC president has demanded an explanation from the Income Tax department after footage showed officials raiding his office, contradicting their claims of no raids.

recent_articles.title: Stalin commends people of T.N. for record voter turnout - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister M.K. Stalin** commended the high voter turnout of 84.69% in Tamil Nadu, which he described as a testament to the people's sense of responsibility and peaceful election process.  He praised voters for their dedication despite the scorching heat and emphasized that this was an election for a generation. **Mr. Stalin** concluded by stating that Tamil Nadu will win on May 4th.
